governance_need.target: An employee can submit a revisioned expense for review and an authorized approver can make a decision that applies only to the exact reviewed revision, with rejection/revision history preserved.
governance_need.current: No implementation exists beyond repository initialization.
governance_need.gap: Submission, revision, authority-safe decision, historical traceability, persistence and browser interaction are absent.

function_loops.target: Employee can create/edit a draft and submit a valid immutable expense revision for review.
Only an authorized approver who is not the submitter can approve or reject the exact submitted revision.
A rejected expense can be revised into a new revision and resubmitted while preserving the rejection and prior revision.
An approval remains attached to the reviewed revision and cannot silently authorize changed approval-relevant content.
function_loops.gap: no binding between decision and revision

function_loops.target: Expense revisions, submissions and decisions remain inspectable as an ordered history.
Expense and decision history survives application/store restart.
Employee and approver can exercise supported paths through a browser UI.
